title_en: 2024–25 Annual Impact Report: A Year of Measurable Growth
title_zh: 2024–25 年度影響力報告：可量度的一年成長
excerpt_en: 6,859 sessions. 490 families. A 30% jump from the year before. Here is what #somuchability looked like in numbers this year.
excerpt_zh: 6,859 節活動、490 個家庭、按年增長 30%——這就是今年 #somuchability 的具體數字。

body_en.text: Every number in this report started as a family walking through our doors for the first time, unsure of what to expect. A year later, those numbers add up to the busiest, most active twelve months in Love 21 Foundation's history.

body_en.label: of spending goes directly to programmes

body_en.text: Where the growth came from

Sport remained our largest programme by volume, but Nutrition and Family sessions grew fastest this year — a sign that families are staying with us for more than one reason. Family Support workshops, launched in December 2024, filled every seat within their first two months.
What 86% actually means

For every HK$100 donated, HK$86 goes straight into coaching, dietitian consultations, family workshops and equipment. The rest covers the administration that keeps that 86% honest — audited accounts, insurance and safeguarding checks.
The full report, including a programme-by-programme breakdown, is available to download below.

body_zh.text: 報告中的每一個數字，都是由一個家庭第一次踏進我們大門開始——當時他們或許還不太清楚會發生什麼事。一年後，這些數字疊加起來，成為 Love 21 基金會歷史上最忙碌、最活躍的十二個月。

body_zh.label: 捐款直接用於服務項目

body_zh.text: 成長從何而來
運動項目在服務節數上仍然佔比最大，但今年增長最快的是營養及家庭支援項目——反映家庭留下來的原因不止一個。於 2024 年 12 月推出的家庭支援工作坊，在短短兩個月內已全部額滿。
86% 究竟代表什麼
每捐出 100 港元，當中 86 港元直接用於教練訓練、營養師諮詢、家庭工作坊及器材添置。餘下部分則用於維持這 86% 誠信可靠所需的行政開支——包括核數、保險及保護措施審查。
完整報告連同各項目的詳細數據，可於下方下載。

title_en: Tables and Seats Now Open for the Beyond Limits Banquet
title_zh: 「超越極限」慈善晚宴現正接受訂座
excerpt_en: Our signature fundraising gala returns this year — book a table or a single seat to support Sport, Nutrition and Family programmes.
excerpt_zh: 我們的年度旗艦籌款晚宴載譽歸來——立即為運動、營養及家庭支援計劃訂座或購票。

body_en.text: Love 21 Foundation is pleased to announce that tables and individual seats for this year's Beyond Limits Banquet are now open for booking.
An evening in support of #somuchability

The Beyond Limits Banquet is Love 21's flagship fundraising evening, bringing together corporate partners, families and long-time supporters for dinner, live entertainment and a look back at the year's programme highlights.
Every table booked funds real sessions: Sport classes, one-on-one Nutrition consultations, and the workshops that make up our Family programme.
How to book
Full tables, half tables and individual seats are all available. For sponsorship packages or group bookings, get in touch with the Love 21 team directly through our Donate page.

body_zh.text: Love 21 基金會欣然宣布，本年度「超越極限」慈善晚宴的整桌及單人座位現已開放預訂。
一同支持 #somuchability 的一個晚上
「超越極限」慈善晚宴是 Love 21 的年度旗艦籌款活動，匯聚企業夥伴、家庭及長期支持者共聚一堂，享用晚餐、欣賞現場表演，並回顧本年度計劃的精彩點滴。
每一枱座位的預訂，都直接資助真實的服務節數：運動課堂、一對一營養諮詢，以及構成我們家庭支援計劃的各項工作坊。
如何訂座
全枱、半枱及單人座位現已全面開放。如欲查詢贊助方案或團體訂座，歡迎透過我們的捐款頁面直接聯絡 Love 21 團隊。

title_en: Love 21 Foundation Charity Raffle 2025: Support the Community, Win Great Prizes
title_zh: Love 21 基金會 2025 年度慈善獎券：支持社群，贏取豐富獎品

excerpt_zh: 2025 年度慈善獎券現正發售，每一張獎券的收益均直接用於運動、營養及家庭支援計劃。

body_en.text: Love 21 Foundation's 2025 Charity Raffle is now open, giving supporters an easy way to back the community while standing a chance to win great prizes.
What your ticket supports
Raffle proceeds go straight into our three core programmes — Sport, Nutrition and Family — the same programmes covered in this year's Annual Impact Report.
Prizes and how to enter
Prizes are contributed by corporate partners and local businesses. Entries can be purchased online or through any Love 21 event before the draw date.
Winners will be announced on our Instagram and notified directly. Good luck — and thank you for backing #somuchability.

body_zh.text: Love 21 基金會 2025 年度慈善獎券現已開售，讓支持者能以輕鬆方式回饋社群，同時有機會贏取豐富獎品。
獎券收益用途
獎券收益將直接投放於我們三大核心計劃——運動、營養及家庭支援，與今年度影響力報告所涵蓋的計劃一致。
獎品及參加方法
獎品由企業夥伴及本地商戶贊助提供。獎券可於網上或於任何 Love 21 活動現場購買，直至抽獎日期截止。

title_en: Special-Needs Teens Take to the Water in New Dragon Boating Partnership
title_zh: 特殊需要青少年首次踏上龍舟 展開全新水上訓練合作計劃
excerpt_en: A Hong Kong yacht club has teamed up with Love 21 Foundation to introduce dragon boating to teens with Down syndrome and autism — a first for many of our participants.
excerpt_zh: 一間香港遊艇會與 Love 21 基金會攜手合作，為患有唐氏綜合症及自閉症的青少年首次引入龍舟訓練。

body_en.text: A new partnership between a Hong Kong yacht club and Love 21 Foundation is putting teenagers with Down syndrome and autism on the water for the first time, learning the paddling, timing and teamwork that dragon boating demands.

Dragon boating asks for the same things our sport classes already build — balance, rhythm and trust in the person next to you. Watching that transfer onto the water has been one of the best parts of this year.

body_en.alt: Love 21 participants wearing life jackets and holding paddles during a dragon boating training session
body_en.caption: Participants during an early training session on the water.

body_en.text: Why the water

Water sports are new territory for most of our Sport programme, and the club's coaches have adapted their usual training plan — shorter sessions, clearer verbal cues, and a coach paired with every two paddlers.
Love 21 is looking to grow this partnership into a regular seasonal offering, alongside the ball games, gymnastics and floor curling already running.

body_zh.text: 一間香港遊艇會與 Love 21 基金會展開全新合作，讓患有唐氏綜合症及自閉症的青少年首次接觸水上運動，學習划槳、節奏配合及龍舟訓練所需的團隊合作。
龍舟運動所需要的，其實與我們運動課堂一直培養的能力一樣——平衡感、節奏感，以及對身旁隊友的信任。看著這些能力延伸到水上，是今年其中一件最令人欣慰的事。
body_zh.attribution: Love 21 基金會運動項目教練

body_zh.alt: Love 21 學員穿著救生衣、手持船槳參與龍舟訓練
body_zh.caption: 學員於早期水上訓練課節中的情況。

body_zh.text: 為何選擇水上運動
水上運動對我們大部分運動項目學員而言都是全新領域，遊艇會教練特別調整了慣常訓練安排——縮短課節時間、簡化口頭指示，並安排每兩名學員配對一名教練。
Love 21 期望將此合作發展成恆常的季節性項目，與現時已推行的球類運動、體操及地板冰壺並行。

title_en: Proving Readiness: Love 21's Push for Purposeful Employment
title_zh: 證明自己準備好了：Love 21 推動有意義的就業機會
excerpt_en: Love 21 Foundation is working to show Hong Kong employers that people with Down syndrome and autism are ready for real, purposeful work — not token placements.
excerpt_zh: Love 21 基金會致力向香港僱主證明，唐氏綜合症及自閉症人士已準備好投入真正有意義的工作，而非象徵式安排。

body_en.text: Love 21 Foundation is stepping up efforts to show Hong Kong employers that members of the Down syndrome and autistic community are ready for purposeful employment — work that uses their actual skills, not symbolic placements.
Skills built long before the interview

The confidence, routine and teamwork our Sport and Family programmes build over months and years turn out to be exactly what employers say they are looking for. Regular attendance, following multi-step instructions, and working alongside teammates are skills our participants practise every single session.
What comes next

Love 21 is building direct relationships with employers willing to look past the CV and meet candidates in person. Corporate partners already engaging through our CSR programme are a natural starting point for these conversations.
If your organisation is exploring inclusive hiring, our CSR programme is a low-commitment way to meet the community first.

body_zh.text: Love 21 基金會正加強努力，向香港僱主證明唐氏綜合症及自閉症社群已準備就緒，能夠投入有意義的工作——運用他們真正的能力，而非象徵式的安排。
早於面試前已建立的能力
我們的運動及家庭支援計劃經過長時間培養出的自信、規律及團隊合作能力，正正是僱主所重視的特質。準時出席、跟從多步驟指示、與隊友合作——這些都是學員在每一節課堂中不斷練習的能力。
下一步
Love 21 正與願意超越履歷、親身與候選人見面的僱主建立直接聯繫。已透過我們企業社會責任計劃參與的企業夥伴，正是展開這些對話的自然起點。
如貴機構正探索共融聘用，我們的企業社會責任計劃提供一個低門檻的方式，讓你先認識這個社群。

title_en: Corporate Volunteers Get Hands-On at a Love 21 Circuit Training Day
title_zh: 企業義工親身參與 Love 21 體適能訓練日
excerpt_en: Employees swapped desks for fitness stations to run a circuit-training session alongside Love 21 participants — and came away with more than they expected.
excerpt_zh: 一班企業員工放下案頭工作，走進運動場地，與 Love 21 學員一同參與體適能訓練日——收穫遠超預期。

body_en.text: As part of our CSR programme, a group of corporate volunteers recently traded their desks for a morning running fitness stations alongside Love 21 participants.
What the day looks like

No sports background is required. Volunteers are briefed by our coaches, then paired to run stations — balance beams, ball drills, stretching circuits — directly with participants, swapping roles throughout the morning.

body_en.alt: Corporate volunteers and Love 21 participants running a fitness station together
body_en.caption: Volunteers and participants pairing up at a fitness station.

body_en.text: It was an incredible experience and one that will stay with us for a long time.
Bring your team
Corporate groups interested in a hands-on CSR day can reach out directly to our Founder & CEO, Jeff Rotmeyer, to discuss dates and group size.

body_zh.text: 作為我們企業社會責任計劃的一部分，一班企業義工早前暫別辦公桌，用一個早上的時間，與 Love 21 學員一同主持體適能訓練站。
活動流程
毋須任何運動背景。義工會先由我們的教練簡介流程，然後兩人一組直接與學員主持訓練站——平衡木、拋接球練習、伸展訓練圈——並於早上輪流交換崗位。

body_zh.alt: 企業義工與 Love 21 學員一同主持體適能訓練站
body_zh.caption: 義工與學員於訓練站中互相配對。

body_zh.text: 這是一次難忘的體驗，將會長久留在我們心中。
帶同你的團隊參與
有意舉辦體驗式企業社會責任活動的機構，歡迎直接聯絡我們的創辦人兼行政總裁 Jeff Rotmeyer，商討日期及人數安排。

title_en: Free Nutrition Guidance Now Reaching Low-Income Families
title_zh: 免費營養指導計劃 惠及基層家庭
excerpt_en: Love 21's Nutrition programme is offering free dietary advice and hands-on cooking guidance to families raising children with intellectual disabilities on limited incomes.
excerpt_zh: Love 21 的營養計劃現正為育有智障兒童的基層家庭，提供免費飲食建議及實務烹飪指導。

body_en.text: Love 21 Foundation's Nutrition programme is extending free dietary guidance to low-income families raising children with intellectual disabilities, recognising that healthy eating advice is only useful if a family can actually afford and manage it.
One-on-one, not one-size-fits-all

Each family meets individually with a dietitian who works around what the household already buys and cooks, rather than prescribing a generic meal plan that assumes a budget or kitchen most families don't have.
In the kitchen together

Regular cooking and food-preparation lessons follow the consultations, teaching parents and children simple, affordable meals side by side — skills that stay with the family long after the sessions end.
The programme is fully free, funded by the 86% of donations that go directly into services.

body_zh.text: Love 21 基金會的營養計劃現正將免費飲食指導擴展至育有智障兒童的基層家庭，因為我們明白，健康飲食建議只有在家庭真正能夠負擔及執行時，才具實際意義。
一對一，而非千篇一律
每個家庭均會獲安排與營養師一對一會面，方案會因應家庭現時的採購及煮食習慣度身訂造，而非假設每個家庭都有相同預算或廚房設備的統一餐單。
一同下廚
諮詢過後，會有定期的烹飪及食物準備課堂，讓家長與子女一同學習簡單、實惠的餐膳製作——這些技能會在課節結束後仍長久留在家庭之中。
此計劃完全免費，資金來自捐款中直接投放於服務項目的 86%。

title_en: Love 21's Open Secret to a Long, Happy Life: Everyday Wellness Habits
title_zh: Love 21 的長壽快樂小秘訣：日常健康習慣
excerpt_en: What do our coaches and dietitians actually tell families to do at home? A few simple habits come up again and again.
excerpt_zh: 我們的教練及營養師到底會建議家庭在家中做些什麼？幾個簡單習慣一直反覆出現。

body_en.text: Ask our coaches and dietitians what actually makes a difference at home, and you won't hear anything complicated. The same few habits come up again and again, whether the family is new to Love 21 or has been with us for years.
Move a little, every day
Consistency beats intensity. A short walk or a few minutes of stretching most days does more for mood, sleep and coordination than one long session a week.
Food is a family activity

body_en.alt: A family chopping vegetables together at a kitchen counter
body_en.caption: Cooking together, not cooking for someone, is what our dietitians recommend.

body_en.text: Our dietitians consistently see better results when the whole family cooks together rather than one person cooking for everyone else — it turns healthy eating into a shared habit instead of a rule imposed on one person.

body_en.myth: Healthy eating means a strict, expensive diet.
body_en.fact: Our dietitians focus on small, affordable swaps a family can realistically keep up long after the programme ends.

body_en.text: Want to help a family build habits like these? Our volunteer programme puts you right alongside our coaches and dietitians — see how to get started.

body_zh.text: 如果你問我們的教練及營養師，究竟在家中做什麼才真正有效，答案往往並不複雜。無論家庭是剛加入 Love 21，還是已經跟我們相處多年，反覆出現的都是同幾個簡單習慣。
每天動一動
持之以恆勝於一次過的高強度。大部分日子進行短時間散步或幾分鐘伸展運動，對情緒、睡眠及協調能力的幫助，遠勝於一星期一次的長時間訓練。
飲食是一家人的活動

body_zh.alt: 一家人於廚房枱面一同切菜
body_zh.caption: 我們的營養師建議一家人一同下廚，而非由一人為所有人烹煮。

body_zh.text: 我們的營養師一致發現，當全家人一同下廚，而非由一人為所有人煮食時，成效往往更佳——這能把健康飲食變成一家人共同的習慣，而非強加於一人身上的規條。

body_zh.myth: 健康飲食代表要遵從嚴格且昂貴的餐單。
body_zh.fact: 我們的營養師著重的是家庭能夠負擔、並在計劃結束後仍能持之以恆的細小飲食調整。

body_zh.text: 想幫助一個家庭建立這些習慣嗎？加入我們的義工計劃，你將與教練及營養師並肩同行——立即了解如何開始。

title_en: What Is Trisomy 21? Understanding the Name Behind Love 21
title_zh: 什麼是 21 三體症？認識 Love 21 名字的由來
excerpt_en: Down syndrome is caused by an extra copy of chromosome 21 — trisomy 21. It's also where our name comes from.
excerpt_zh: 唐氏綜合症由第 21 號染色體多出一條複本所致，稱為「21 三體症」——這正是我們名字的由來。

body_en.text: Down syndrome is caused by trisomy 21 — the presence of a third copy of chromosome 21, instead of the usual two. That extra genetic material shapes physical development and learning in ways doctors have studied for decades, but it doesn't define what a person can achieve.
Why we're called Love 21
Our name is a direct reference to that 21st chromosome — a small nod to the science, wrapped around a much bigger idea: that a diagnosis is a starting point, not a ceiling.

body_en.myth: Down syndrome is a disease that needs to be cured.
body_en.fact: Down syndrome is a genetic difference, not an illness. Our programmes focus on ability and support, not treatment.

body_en.text: Want to see #somuchability in action? Our volunteer programme is one of the easiest ways to meet the community behind the name.

body_zh.text: 唐氏綜合症是由「21 三體症」所引致——即第 21 號染色體出現第三條複本，而非正常的兩條。這額外的遺傳物質，會以醫學界多年來研究的方式影響身體發展及學習能力，但這並不能定義一個人所能達到的成就。
為何我們稱為 Love 21
我們的名字直接呼應第 21 號染色體——既是對科學事實的致意，同時亦承載著一個更宏大的理念：診斷結果只是一個起點，而非能力的上限。

body_zh.myth: 唐氏綜合症是一種需要治療的疾病。
body_zh.fact: 唐氏綜合症是一種遺傳差異，而非疾病。我們的計劃著重能力發展及支援，而非治療。

body_zh.text: 想親身見證 #somuchability 嗎？加入我們的義工計劃，是認識這個名字背後社群的最簡單方法之一。

title_en: What to Expect as a First-Time Love 21 Volunteer
title_zh: 首次擔任 Love 21 義工：你需要知道的事
excerpt_en: Nervous about your first session? Here's what actually happens, from arrival to your first high-five.
excerpt_zh: 對第一次做義工感到緊張？以下是由抵達到第一次擊掌的完整流程。

body_en.text: Most first-time volunteers arrive with the same question: what am I actually supposed to do? Here's what a typical first session looks like, start to finish.
Before you arrive

No experience or qualifications are required. You'll get a short briefing from a Love 21 coach before the session starts, covering the day's activities and the participants you'll be working alongside.
During the session

You'll be paired with a coach and one or more participants, helping run a station, a drill, or simply keeping pace alongside someone during an activity. Coaches stay close by the whole time — you're never running a session alone.
After it's over
Sessions typically wrap with a short debrief, where coaches answer questions and volunteers can ask about future sessions or ongoing programmes to get involved with.
Ready to sign up for your first session? Head to our volunteer page to see upcoming dates.

body_zh.text: 大部分首次擔任義工的朋友，都會有同一個疑問：我到底要做什麼？以下由頭到尾說明一次典型的首節義工體驗。
出發前
毋須任何經驗或資格。課節開始前，Love 21 教練會為你進行簡短簡介，講解當日活動內容，以及你將會一同參與的學員情況。
課節期間
你會與一位教練及一位或多位學員配對，協助主持訓練站、練習項目，或是在活動中陪伴學員一同進行。教練全程都在附近——你絕不會需要獨自主持課節。
課節完結後
課節一般會以簡短總結作結，教練會解答疑問，義工亦可查詢未來課節或其他可參與的持續計劃。
準備好報名參加首節義工體驗了嗎？前往我們的義工頁面，查看即將舉行的日期。
